overview.commentary: The portfolio returned 52.57% annualised against 25.70% volatility (Sharpe 1.60) — excellent risk-adjusted performance at a elevated risk level. KHC carries the largest weight at 3.0%; MRNA dominates risk contribution at 10.5%. On a typical bad day expect losses near 2.96% (95% VaR), with the worst 5% averaging 3.63% (CVaR) and peak-to-trough drawdown over the period of -11.40%. Action: profile looks balanced; monitor correlation drift around the next earnings cycle.

risk.commentary: Monte Carlo (10k paths, 1Y horizon): 95% VaR 8.43%, 99% VaR 19.00%, CVaR 95% 14.81%. Probability of >20% loss: 0.78%. Worst historical replay is GFC_peak_to_trough (-56.44% return, max drawdown -58.19%, worst day -13.62%). GARCH(1,1) 30-day forecast vol is 19.23% vs realised 18.88% — vol regime rising. Persistence alarm: ARE, AIG, MRNA, MU, WDC, SNDK, LITE, LEN, STX, FISV, CVS, EQT have α+β > 0.95, meaning shocks decay slowly — drawdowns there will compound longer than a Gaussian model would imply.

liquidity.commentary: AUM $1,000,000 across 47 positions. The most concentrated trade is ARE at 0.0% of 30-day ADV.
